output.subject: We've received your complaint about two NSF returned item fees
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch with us. We have received your complaint and want to confirm what you told us.

You mentioned that your statement shows two charges of $34.00 labeled "NSF RETURNED ITEM FEE," and that both appear to relate to the same $610 electric payment. You asked whether you were charged more than once, and you asked for an explanation of these charges or for the extra charges to be reversed. You also told us you would like to hear back this week, and that you are considering moving your accounts elsewhere if you don't.

We understand how confusing it can be to see charges on your statement that you weren't expecting, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days. If there is anything else you'd like us to consider, such as further details about the payment, please reply to this message.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Complaint text asks for a reply confirming a $750 refund was issued today; no refund is confirmed in the draft and none should be stated unless actually decided.
Customer expects a response this week; draft only gives the 10 business day timeframe. Decide whether earlier contact is possible.
Customer is threatening to move accounts to another institution; consider retention handling.
Verify whether the two $34.00 NSF fees relate to the same $610 electric payment (e.g., re-presentment) and decide on explanation and any reversal.
Customer asks for both an explanation and a reversal; ensure the final response addresses both.
